@@ -1 +1,27 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+Install it first if it is not already available:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pip install pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py   # a single file
+python3 -m pytest -k reconcile                  # tests matching a name
+python3 -m pytest -v                            # one line per test
+```
+
+Note: no tests are committed yet, so the command above currently collects
+nothing and exits without running anything. Add test files as `tests/test_*.py`
+and pytest will pick them up automatically.
